title: AC1024 persistent-subentity-manager opaque proxy projection
scope: Two retained AC1024 ODA DXF outputs compared with exact source DWG frame captures and generated ASCII/Binary codec controls.

oda_file_converter.fresh_resave_attempt: aborted with macOS pasteboard/XPC errors; retained ODA outputs were used

observations.typed_to_raw_binding: Each typed manager record is bound by import generation and handle to one exact captured source frame; record/class identity, owner, reactors, xdictionary and source class metadata are checked.
observations.output_census: The retained ODA proxy census equals the complete captured ACSH plus the two manager frames for each input. Ordered group fields and payload spans are compared; the two manager groups are emitted in the observed reactor-before-owner order.
observations.roles: For both sampled inputs each manager has one reactor equal to its owner, a unique typed DICTIONARY target, no xdictionary, and no class-specific object-ID body references. Wrong-kind owner/reference and owner/reactor-to-MATERIAL mutations refuse atomically.
observations.class_rows: ODA CLASS output IDs are resolved by CLASS row identity/order. Both manager CLASS rows report instanceCount 2 in retained ODA outputs while source class metadata reports 1; implementation permits this exact observed relation only for these two classes and one captured frame each.
observations.codec_readback: Generated ASCII and Binary controls verify class metadata, proxy fields, owner/reactor ordering and typed readback, including corrected retry after refusal.
limitations: Evidence is limited to two retained AC1024 ODA outputs and their exact source frames.
A fresh ODA resave could not be completed because the CLI aborted with macOS pasteboard/XPC errors.
Three source object parser failures remain on each input; opaque transport does not establish their semantics.
Strict whole-document output/readback, other producer/version profiles, native consumer semantics and 3D support are not qualified.

fixture_policy: No new DWG/DXF fixture files are committed; existing source files and retained external outputs were used.
status: bounded implementation evidence only; P4 remains open
